description: Eight crops of engraved model handwriting from two public-domain penmanship manuals (Palmer 1915, Zaner 1925 printing of the 1915 edition): running sentences, no drills. A neat reference for scripts/calibrate.py, the ideal end of the range: adult cursive drawn as a model to copy, not children's everyday writing.
